subject: general
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65e69fd3a9a8bbf842bc1288a69c63c3ac9f4f382520109a24bbec799afb1e4f.png]
solution:
Explanation:

When we compare both the figures we get,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5850c85f93991eba2a1a4f3b884bfcd5328d8c7ed31d2ff25f705acdacf8ff4e.png] 

We observe that, when we move the dice upwards towards right such that 3 and 2 are visible we find that on the left we have 1 and on the right we have

3 which means they both are opposite to each other. So 1 is the number on the face opposite the face showing 3.

Hence, **"Option 4"** is the correct answer
